require 'openssl'
require 'async'
require 'async/barrier'
require 'json'

module CryptoService
  class KeyRegistry
    attr_reader :keys

    def initialize
      @keys = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def register(key_id, key_material)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @keys[key_id] = key_material
      end
    end

    def fetch(key_id)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @keys[key_id]
      end
    end
  end

  class SignatureContext
    attr_accessor :algorithm, :key_ref, :payload_digest

    def initialize(algorithm:, key_ref:, payload_digest:)
      @algorithm = algorithm
      @key_ref = key_ref
      @payload_digest = payload_digest
    end

    def to_signing_input
      # Returns the digest bytes for signing
      @payload_digest
    end
  end

  class AsyncVerifier
    def initialize(registry)
      @registry = registry
      @pending_contexts = {}
      @results = {}
    end

    def enqueue_verification(request_id, context, signature)
      @pending_contexts[request_id] = { context: context, signature: signature }
    end

    def resolve_key_material(key_ref)
      material = @registry.fetch(key_ref)
      return nil unless material
      coerce_key(material)
    end

    def coerce_key(material)
      # Accept both PEM strings and raw key objects
      case material
      when OpenSSL::PKey::PKey
        material
      when String
        OpenSSL::PKey.read(material)
      when Hash
        # JWK-style key material - reconstruct from components
        reconstruct_from_jwk(material)
      else
        # Attempt duck-type coercion for proxy objects
        if material.respond_to?(:to_pem)
          OpenSSL::PKey.read(material.to_pem)
        elsif material.respond_to?(:to_der)
          OpenSSL::PKey.read(material.to_der)
        else
          material
        end
      end
    end

    def reconstruct_from_jwk(jwk_hash)
      case jwk_hash['kty']
      when 'RSA'
        build_rsa_from_jwk(jwk_hash)
      when 'EC'
        build_ec_from_jwk(jwk_hash)
      else
        raise "Unsupported key type: #{jwk_hash['kty']}"
      end
    end

    def build_rsa_from_jwk(jwk)
      # Simplified JWK to RSA conversion
      n = base64url_to_bn(jwk['n'])
      e = base64url_to_bn(jwk['e'])
      key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new
      key.set_key(n, e, nil) if key.respond_to?(:set_key)
      key
    end

    def build_ec_from_jwk(jwk)
      group = case jwk['crv']
              when 'P-256' then OpenSSL::PKey::EC::Group.new('prime256v1')
              when 'P-384' then OpenSSL::PKey::EC::Group.new('secp384r1')
              else raise "Unsupported curve"
              end
      key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(group)
      key
    end

    def base64url_to_bn(str)
      decoded = str.tr('-_', '+/').then { |s|
        s += '=' * (4 - s.length % 4) % 4
        require 'base64'
        Base64.decode64(s)
      }
      OpenSSL::BN.new(decoded, 2)
    end

    def perform_verification(request_id)
      entry = @pending_contexts[request_id]
      return { verified: false, error: 'not_found' } unless entry

      ctx = entry[:context]
      sig = entry[:signature]

      key = resolve_key_material(ctx.key_ref)
      return { verified: false, error: 'key_resolution_failed' } unless key

      digest_input = ctx.to_signing_input
      verified = execute_verify(key, ctx.algorithm, digest_input, sig)
      { verified: verified, request_id: request_id }
    end

    def execute_verify(key, algorithm, digest_input, signature)
      digest_alg = map_algorithm(algorithm)

      # Type-aware verification dispatch
      case key
      when OpenSSL::PKey::RSA
        key.verify(digest_alg, signature, digest_input)
      when OpenSSL::PKey::EC
        key.dsa_verify_asn1(digest_input, signature)
      else
        # Fallback: use generic verify if available
        if key.respond_to?(:verify)
          key.verify(digest_alg, signature, digest_input)
        else
          false
        end
      end
    end

    def map_algorithm(algorithm)
      case algorithm.to_s.downcase
      when 'rs256', 'es256' then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new
      when 'rs384', 'es384' then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA384.new
      when 'rs512', 'es512' then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA512.new
      else OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new
      end
    end
  end

  class BatchProcessor
    def initialize(registry)
      @verifier = AsyncVerifier.new(registry)
    end

    def process_batch(requests)
      results = []

      Async do |task|
        barrier = Async::Barrier.new

        requests.each_with_index do |req, idx|
          barrier.async do
            context = build_context(req)
            request_id = "req_#{idx}_#{Time.now.to_f}"
            @verifier.enqueue_verification(request_id, context, decode_signature(req))
            result = @verifier.perform_verification(request_id)
            results << result
          end
        end

        barrier.wait
      end

      results
    end

    private

    def build_context(req)
      payload = req['payload'] || req[:payload]
      algorithm = req['algorithm'] || req[:algorithm] || 'RS256'
      key_ref = req['key_id'] || req[:key_id]

      digest = compute_payload_digest(payload, algorithm)

      SignatureContext.new(
        algorithm: algorithm,
        key_ref: key_ref,
        payload_digest: digest
      )
    end

    def compute_payload_digest(payload, algorithm)
      digest_cls = case algorithm.to_s.upcase
                   when /256/ then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256
                   when /384/ then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA384
                   when /512/ then OpenSSL::Digest::SHA512
                   else OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256
                   end
      digest_cls.digest(payload.to_s)
    end

    def decode_signature(req)
      sig = req['signature'] || req[:signature]
      return '' unless sig
      require 'base64'
      Base64.urlsafe_decode64(sig) rescue sig
    end
  end
end
